thread:
Zoe (Sales): FYI NorthWell POC hitting 429s on their scripted demo at ~5m. Tenant: northwell-poc. Can infra triage?

Ibrahim (Platform SE): What endpoint/model and any 429 payloads or headers? Streaming or non-streaming?

Zoe (Sales): They called POST /v1/chat/respond (redwood-8k), non-streaming. Customer pasted: \n\nHTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests\nContent-Type: application/json\n{\n  "error": "rate_limit",\n  "detail": "burst cap exceeded"\n}\nX-RateLimit-Limit: 800\nX-RateLimit-Remaining: 0\nX-RateLimit-Reset: 14\n\nThey were running ~90 concurrent sessions with max_tokens=400.

Felix (SRE): Pulling logs for northwell-poc. Hosted tenant; default burst window is token-equivalent sliding 60s.

June (Support): Log excerpt: \n\n2026-05-10T15:12:08Z tenant=northwell-poc concurrent=92 tokens_window=60 tokens_used=36000 cap=800 remain=0\n2026-05-10T15:12:12Z tenant=northwell-poc 429 burst cap hit\n\nIbrahim (Platform SE): Two immediate mitigations: advise customer to lower max_tokens to 200 and enable streaming + client-side concurrency limit (30). Or we can apply a short demo bump.

Rowan (AE): NorthWell is trialing for an enterprise deployment. Approve a one-time demo bump to 2000 for 90 minutes, provide we collect graphs & logs.

Felix (SRE): I'll apply per-route burst cap=2000 ttl=5400s and turn on debug token sampling. Will watch error rate and latency.

RateBot: Change request queued: CR-9467.

June (Support): Patch applied by Felix. PatchID=cr-9467. During bump peak concurrent reached 160 and we did not observe 429s.

Ibrahim (Platform SE): Sent client snippet to customer to reduce tokens/concurrency:\n\nconst limit = new Pool({concurrency:30});\nawait limit.run(() => chat({max_tokens:200, stream:true}));\n\nFelix (SRE): After TTL expiry config reverted and 429s resumed within ~4min under identical load. Saved logs/screenshots to CR-9467 and flagged for AE handoff.

Rowan (AE): Demo success; initiating handoff and recommending Dedicated sizing. Adding notes to opportunity.

Zoe (Sales): Thanks all. Recommend adding a short blurb to POC checklist: warn about token-heavy non-streaming workloads and the demo-bump process. Closing thread.
